proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.from_remaining_charge_pool
proposed_widenings.justification: Retributive Strike damage scales from the current remaining charges in the item, not from charges spent or level scaling.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.partial_property_loss_on_last_charge_roll
proposed_widenings.justification: The staff does not get destroyed or become wholly nonmagical on a failed last-charge roll; it keeps only its quarterstaff +2 bonus and loses its other properties.
proposed_widenings.evidence: On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties.

notes: The top-level kind and composite magic-item family fit, and most passive/spellcasting mechanics already map to existing atoms. I stopped before authoring because Retributive Strike needs damage derived from remaining charge-pool state, and the last-charge failure needs a degraded-item lifecycle shape rather than destruction.
